patterns: Can I see a list of majors?
responses: EMU offers a wide range of majors including Nursing, Business, Computer Science, Education, Psychology, and more. You can view the full list at [emu.edu/academics/programs](https://emu.edu/academics/programs).
Visit the Academics page at EMU for a complete list of majors and programs: [emu.edu/academics/programs](https://emu.edu/academics/programs).

patterns: What are the most popular majors?
responses: Some of EMU’s most popular majors include Nursing, Biology, Psychology, Education, and Business Administration.
Nursing, Business, and Teacher Education are among the top programs at EMU.

patterns: I don't know what to major in
How do I choose a major?
responses: No worries—EMU offers guidance through academic advisors and the Career Services Center to help you explore interests and choose a major that fits your goals.
If you're undecided, EMU has exploratory pathways and advising to help you discover what you're passionate about. You’ll get support all the way through.

patterns: How do I change my major?
Is it easy to change my major?
responses: Yes, you can change your major. Talk to your academic advisor and they’ll help you fill out a change of major form.
To switch majors, just speak with your current advisor or the department you're switching to. They’ll walk you through the process.
Yes! You can double major or add a minor. It’s a good idea to meet with your academic advisor to plan your course schedule accordingly.
EMU allows students to double major or choose from a variety of minors. Talk with your advisor to see what fits your goals and timeline.

patterns: What are the requirements for the Computer Science major?
How many credits is the Nursing major?
What courses are required for Psychology?
responses: Each major has specific course requirements. You can view them by visiting [emu.edu/academics/programs](https://emu.edu/academics/programs) and selecting your major.
Check the course catalog or academic department page for detailed major requirements. Your advisor can also help with planning.
